title: Literary
subtitle: 本課集中處理 literary = relating to literature / interested in books and literature / having the
description: 本課集中處理 literary = relating to literature / interested in books and literature / having the qualities of crafted literary writing。 它至少有三個常見方向：客觀地與文學有關、形容人很愛文學、形容寫作具有文學創作感。

words.example: The archive contains documents relating to literature and publishing.
words.exampleZh: 這個檔案庫收藏與文學及出版有關的文件。

exercises.original: The archive contains literary documents from the nineteenth century.
exercises.zh: 檔案庫收藏十九世紀的文學相關文件。

options.explanation: Relating to literature ✓ — connected with literature, literary works, writers, or literary study。這句的決定性線索是 the documents are connected with literature。因此 Relating to literature 最準確表達這種 literary。
Literature-related — connected with literature or literary activity。literature-related 只是一般『與文學有關』；若句子重點是人的書卷氣、寫作風格或 programme focus，另有更精準詞。
Academic — relating to education or scholarly study。academic 可屬任何學科，只表示學術／教育，不等於文學。
Scholarly — showing academic research or learning。scholarly 強調研究／學術性，不表示與文學相關。
Fictional — invented rather than factual。fictional 只表示虛構；文學包括非虛構、詩歌、散文等。
Poetic — relating to poetry or having poetic qualities。poetic 只適合詩歌或具詩意的風格，範圍比 literary 窄。

options.explanation: Relating to literature — connected with literature, literary works, writers, or literary study。這是廣義解釋性替代；若句子要突出現代複合形容詞、個人興趣或 writerly style，會太一般。
Academic — relating to education or scholarly study。academic 可屬任何學科，只表示學術／教育，不等於文學。
Of a literary kind ✓ — belonging to or having the qualities of literature。這句的決定性線索是 classification by literary type is central。因此 Of a literary kind 最準確表達這種 literary。
Scholarly — showing academic research or learning。scholarly 強調研究／學術性，不表示與文學相關。
Fictional — invented rather than factual。fictional 只表示虛構；文學包括非虛構、詩歌、散文等。
Textual — relating to a text。textual 只表示關於文本；文本未必是文學。

falseSynonyms.zh: 學術的 ≠ literary academic 可屬任何學科，不等於文學。
學術研究的 ≠ literary scholarly 強調研究嚴謹，不代表與文學相關。
虛構的 ≠ literary fictional 只表示虛構；文學可以是非虛構。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fictional is genre/truth-status focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詩意的 ≠ all literary poetic 只適合詩歌或具詩意風格。
只在人／氣質／興趣 sense 接近 bookish 不能代替 literary criticism / literary theory。
只在寫作風格 sense 接近 writerly 不能代替一般『與文學有關』。
文本的 ≠ literary textual 只是關於文本，未必是文學文本。
詞性陷阱 literature 是名詞；literary 是形容詞。
